app.theme: lib/theme/volt.dart (VoltPalette dark and light; Volt.* getters)
app.test: flutter test; screenshots: SHOTS=1 flutter test test/shots --update-goldens (out/ is git-ignored)
app.test_builds: Release workflow (workflow_dispatch, platform both|ios|android): TestFlight + Play internal; runs from any branch

control_center.icons: site/admin/lib/icons.js, generated by tool/cc_icons.py from the icons-library repo

deploy: GitHub Pages (.github/workflows/site.yml) deploys site/ on push to main
